notes.title: Final Preparations Update
notes.notes:
Hey there Banas! We're making one update to get ready for the HUGE amount of content coming up soon, no spoilers today ;)

There's quite a bit to unpack so let's just get right down to the list of major features:

[h1]Opening Cutscene[/h1]

You'll have to see for yourself, but upon starting a fresh save file, Apple will give you a friendly introduction and tell you the story of how the evil Shadow Bana came to power in the first place. This is part of our attempt to orient Bana Simulator more towards it's rich storyline and share some of the deep lore beneath the Game's surface.

[h1]General Features[/h1]

[list]
[*] Complete overhaul of the Bana Rang
[*] Graphical overhaul of the Bana Blade
[*] Partial gameplay overhaul of the Bana Bow
[*] Added Poison damage
[*] Added Fire Damage
[*] Remade low-health indicators
[*] Significantly nerfed potassium buffer
[*] Rewrote some tutorial levels
[*] Idiot-proofed minigames
[*] Added (Are you ready for this) FLOORS!!
[/list]

[h1]New Weapons[/h1]

These weapons will be fully implemented in the very-near future with the next chapters of the Bana's story. For now you can only access them in endless mode.

[h3]Sunpower[/h3]

A medium-damage beam weapon that can hit many targets or plant a weaker flower as a sentry turret.

[h3]Haunted Hammer[/h3]

A high-damage melee weapon that can deal very high damage and gains power as it absorbs enemy's souls. Has a secondary drop-swing attack. This will eventually be a reward for a Halloween themed "Pumpkin Gourdian" boss.

[h3]Toxic Tentacle[/h3]

A new flail-type weapon that deals heavy poison damage.

[h3]Petal-rang[/h3]

A type of aquatic flower found in high cliffs that has sharp petals, usable as a high-power weapon.

[h3]Bramble Bow[/h3]

Launch brambles that trail your arrow or plant giant poisonous bushes.

[h3]Slingshot[/h3]

I really hope you know what one of these is...

[h3]Peblet Golems[/h3]

Little golems that you can throw at your enemies. Extremely cute, but even more deadly.

[h1]Setting the Stage[/h1]

It's no secret that we have a big update coming soon, as much as we'd like to share every detail of it now, some of the features aren't ready. There are dozens of hidden enemies, weapons, and levels included in the files of this update that won't be visible in any way just yet, but be patient. The wait won't be long...

All I will share is that the next update will include multiplayer networking, so get the word about Bana Simulator to your friends.

[h1]Play it Today - Beta Testers wanted!![/h1]

We will be giving out many more beta copies in preparation for the final stretch of Closed Beta development, so please get the word out to your friends, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/qUzBDU6zZP]Discord Server[/url] for more information on how you or your friends can play Bana Simulator for free as soon as possible.

notes.title: The Heavy Metal Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New Levels[/h1]

Bana Simulator has gained 5 new levels, each introducing new mechanics and incredible challenges, mechanics, and enemies. No full island was added in this update, but a small side-island off the coast of Isla Bana.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/b903dd4f316b3de40ed1b8dd3dbe2ea0a719b1de.png[/img]

[h2]Ballista Minigame[/h2]

The third of the new levels will have something very obvious to the player, a giant rolling ballista. The Spear Island off the coast of Isla Bana happened to have this lost weapon the Alchemist was working on. Shoot the targets and tread carefully because the enemies here are lethal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/3673db70850cb055e5edce7627f448753e582eae.png[/img]

[h2]New Enemies[/h2]

A large number of new enemies (mostly spear themed) are added with the Heavy Metal Update. 
[list]
[*] Exploding Spears,
[*] Spear Dashers,
[*] Coconuts,
[*] Sporb,
[*] Sporborb,
[*] Explorb
[/list]
just for a little taste.

[h3]Palm Trees[/h3]

The aforementioned coconuts do not spawn ordinarily but are summoned by Palm Trees. Every minute palm trees spawn a cluster of 3-5 coconuts. Although they are not significantly stronger than normal enemies, the coconuts can deal incredible damage in clusters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/d761e0131301f4c14a72ab60d4a493a802e601fe.png[/img]

[h1]Armor[/h1]

Enemies can now become much fiercer by donning armor.
[olist]
[*] Plank Armor
[list]
[*] +1 Defense
[/list]
[*] Stone/Brick Armor
[list]
[*] +2 Defense
[*] +1 Attack
[/list]
[*] Copper Armor
[list]
[*] +3 Defense
[*] +1 Attack
[/list]
[*] Cobalt Armor
[list]
[*] +4 Defense
[*] +2 Attack
[/list]
[*] Gold Armor
[list]
[*] +5 Defense
[*] +2 Attack
[*] +2 Health
[/list]
[*] Shadow Armor
[list]
[*] +7 Defense
[*] +4 Attack
[*] +4 Health
[/list]
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/4cbd9e2dc27f4bad3bb6def772709276c0384a3a.png[/img]

[h1]Visual Improvements[/h1]

[h3]Damage Indicators[/h3]
From RPGs like [i]Final Fantasy[/i] to sandboxes like [i]Terraria[/i], almost every game out there has damage indicators to give players a sense of just how powerful their weapons are, and some players have had a tough time choosing weapons, so we added damage indicators to Bana Simulator!

[h3]New Lighting Effects[/h3]
New VFX have been added to enemy lasers, sunlight, weapons, and more! These effects have made the Bana Beam's special attack so much more satisfying to use...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/9ab30f1088d183b8b1e2fad0da2b49a5093cbe1d.png[/img]

[h1]Supreme Spear Bossfight[/h1]

Some of you may remember this guy from the [i]really[/i] early days of Bana Simulator and will be happy to find out it has returned along with a *much* better weapon reward. No spoilers, but there's quite a few attacks here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/27a225a67174f6a832c19e0f142b4136350c995c.png[/img]

[h2]Competition Results[/h2]

The Space Race Competition is now complete, and the winner is... Wow this is quite a username, Urmomissus, who submitted their entry on the first day of the competition. We should be getting their customized weapon in the next patch. 

[h1]QOL Changes[/h1]

Changed current save slots to "Rollback Slots" and added a system of 3 save files. With this we also introduced backup save files, to prevent the tragic loss of a Bana that many players have experienced.

[h3]Hardcore[/h3]
The classic Permadeath game mode has found its way into Bana Simulator. Dying during the campaign will erase the players save file, excluding Endless Mode games on record, obtained skins, and Banacoin. Dying during endless mode will have no effect, despite being permadeath mode.

[h3]New Title Screen[/h3]
The title screen has been redesigned for a dark theme and the [i]Simulator[/i] text now gives the "neon" effect shown in the trailer. New animations for navigating in menus and the title screen have been added for a smoother experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/760c32c8c47c27963eeff03f8ebce596df483abb.png[/img]

[h3]Reworked Loading Screen[/h3]
The old grey screen with a loading bar was always temporary (and excruciatingly boring), so we made a permanent loading screen with an animation and a fun background. To make the animation less laggy, saving has been threaded (fancy computer science words) so it runs very smoothly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/b5045c1471824450c9e1d54888ba108230aab9a7.png[/img]

notes.title: First Minor Update
notes.notes:
Hey there Banas!! Our closed Beta launch yesterday went very well, and our first beta reviews are fantastic! That being said, we have received quite a few bug reports, and a few of our major features weren't working! We managed to release not one, but two updates to fix these problems!! Here's some of the changes!


[b]Hotfix 8295-A[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed lounge not properly loading after a level. 
[*] Changed the 'shop' button to a 'skins' button
[*] Increased the range of electrob- super secret weapon!
[*] Enemies/potassium can no longer spawn near walls, traps, or the player.
[*] Removed the bullet ring from endless mode
[*] Added the quad-ray to endless mode
[*] Added a new level- the memory
[/list]

[b]MacOS Support[/b]

Although we thought we had this one from the start, some of our players pointed out that the game didn't open properly through MacOS. We have not only solved this problem, but improved this version of the game to be as responsive as it can be and have extra smooth gameplay.

[b]Hotfix 8295-B[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed 'Scrapper' achievement not loading properly in steam
[*] Added 'Bodey B.' to the credits
[*] Bana Bow no longer aims when the game is paused.
[*] Bana Bow will no longer consume potassium if a regular arrow has already been drawn back, instead it will be replaced by a charged arrow.
[*] Fixed a crash in level 5 where apple would say "SURPRI" and end the universe 
[*] Bana Bow will now do more damage the more you draw back
[*] Bana Bow will now launch arrows extra fast for easy aiming
[*] Bana Superbeam will now do double damage
[*] Supercharged Bana Arrows do triple damage
[*] Bana Ball Chargers now do more damage that Bana bullets
[*] The low health overlay is now togglable
[/list]
